name: ntorq-companion
description: Ntorq Companion - a personal companion app for the TVS Ntorq 125 Race XP (React Native app + Express/MongoDB API)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.adb:reverse: adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 && adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix mobile test
